messages:
maria (marketing): Hey team — draft for the Redwood Optimize launch post is ready. Can we lock publish date, webinar CTA, and HubSpot routing?

alexa (growth): Prefer Tues 9:00 PT so sales gets Monday to prep sequences. Also want a hero CTA that promotes the webinar + benchmark read.

rishi (product): Tuesday works. Confirming the benchmark callouts: 2.3x median latency improvement and ~36% lower unit cost. Need methodology footnote and link.

taylor (growthops): Draft routing: blog form -> list: launch_optimize; webinar signups -> tag: webinar_early; CTA click -> workflow: nurture_optimize. Will append `?utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_medium=blog`.

kate (legal): Quick review: avoid absolutes. Please add this footnote text: "Benchmarks run on internal eval suite; representative workloads only. Methodology: https://redwood.ai/benchmarks/optimize-2026" Also confirm partner quote approvals.

sam (design): Need final hero image (1200x630) and short hero quote (max 70 chars). Uploaded two mockups — prefer v2 but need alt text.

maria (marketing): Draft hero quote: "Reduce inference cost by 36% while speeding up responses." Tightening to 70 chars. Also adding a hero CTA: [Register for webinar] and secondary: [Read the benchmark].

alexa (growth): A/B test ideas: subject A = "How we cut inference cost 36% — Redwood Optimize"; subject B = "See 2.3x faster LLM responses in our benchmark". Add `utm_experiment=subjA` / `subjB`.

taylor (growthops): Will configure HubSpot experiments and map `webinar_early -> queue: optimize_sdr`. Also set form fields: name, email, company, role, use case, consent.

rishi (product): Landing page ready for copy. I'll add the short benchmark paragraph and link to the eval appendix. Webinar scheduled Apr 21 10:00 PT — adding to widget.

kate (legal): :thumbsup: on footnote and consent language. Please include "used with permission" under any customer quotes and attach approval doc.

sam (design): Uploaded og:image `optimize-hero-v2.png`. Alt text: "line chart comparing latency before and after Redwood Optimize". Still need the final 65-char hero quote.

publish-bot: Checklist summary: missing items -> hero quote (final), testimonial approval file, and og:image `alt` confirmation. Run `/schedule publish 2026-04-20T16:00Z` after checklist complete.

maria (marketing): OK I'll finalize hero quote and chase testimonial sign-off. Plan: embargo partner preview Mon 9:00 PT. If everyone :thumbsup: by EOD Fri, I'll lock publish Tue 9:00 PT.

alexa (growth): :thumbsup: from growth. I'll prepare social cadence (+15m, +4h, +24h) once assets are live.

taylor (growthops): :thumbsup: will validate HubSpot routing in staging.

rishi (product): :thumbsup: landing page ready to go.

kate (legal): :thumbsup: legal docs attached to the thread (Doc ID 9021).

sam (design): :thumbsup: hero quote candidates uploaded in Drive.

maria (marketing): Thanks all — locking timeline if no objections.
